biggest_catch: Mana is play money with ZERO cash value — it cannot be converted to cash or withdrawn. Trading on Manifold earns leaderboard points, not income; treating it as a way to 'make money' is a category error.
catches: Mana (M) has no cash value and cannot be withdrawn or converted to USD, crypto, or gift cards
Free prize drawings for real USDC are sweepstakes — entry is free but winning is uncertain and never guaranteed
Real-money 'Sweepcash' trading layer was discontinued in March 2025; the platform is play-money only
Mana can be purchased with dollars (optional), so the platform can cost money while paying nothing out
Markets are resolved by the market creator (trust-based, not a regulated oracle)

Receive M1,000 of play-money Mana automatically on signup
